# openclaude

> Open-source coding agent that runs in your terminal and talks to any model:
> OpenAI-compatible APIs, Google Gemini, GitHub Models, local Ollama, and
> gateways like OpenRouter and LiteLLM. One install, every provider.
> Maintained by GitLawb. Install: `npm install -g @gitlawb/openclaude@latest`

openclaude reads and edits files, runs shell commands, searches codebases, and
talks to MCP servers — permission-gated, with every change reviewable. It is
a fork-friendly, model-neutral alternative to single-vendor coding agents.

## Docs

- [Documentation overview](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/): what openclaude is and how the docs are organized
- [Installation](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/installation/): npm install on macOS, Linux, Windows; AUR package; troubleshooting
- [Quickstart](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/quickstart/): first session in five minutes — start, pick a provider, task, review
- [Providers](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/providers/): all 14 supported backends with setup paths and env vars
- [Slash commands reference](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/slash-commands/): all 69 in-session commands with argument hints
- [CLI reference](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/cli-reference/): every flag of the openclaude binary, plus subcommands
- [Configuration](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/configuration/): settings.json hierarchy, common options, environment variables
- [Keybindings](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/keybindings/): default shortcuts and ~/.claude/keybindings.json customization
- [Skills](https://openclaude.gitlawb.com/docs/skills/): bundled agent skills and how to write your own

## Project

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Gitlawb/openclaude): source, issues, releases
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gitlawb/openclaude): @gitlawb/openclaude
- [gitlawb](https://gitlawb.com): the decentralized git network openclaude is aligned with
